question.problem: A particle moves along a **clockwise** circular path with center $O$ in the $xy$-plane with a constant angular velocity of $4\text{ rad/s}.$ Given that the object is at the position $(9,0)$ when $t=0,$ find the position function of the particle.
question.worked_solution:
The position function of a particle moving in a circular path of radius $R$ in the $xy$-plane with a constant angular velocity $\omega $ is given by

$$
r(t)=R(\operatorname{cos}⁡\omega t\,i+\operatorname{sin}⁡\omega t\,j),
$$

where it is assumed that the circle is centered at $O,$ and particle is at the position $(R,0)$ when $t=0.$

Since the object's initial position is $(9,0),$ we have that $r(0)=\,9i,$ and we can conclude that the radius of the circle $R=9.$

Therefore, since we have $R=9$ and $\omega =-4\text{ rad/s}$ (negative because the motion is clockwise), we get that the position function is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}r(t) & =9(\operatorname{cos}⁡(-4t)\,i+\operatorname{sin}⁡(-4t)\,j) \\  & =9(\operatorname{cos}⁡4t\,i-\operatorname{sin}⁡4t\,j).\end{aligned}
$$
